description: One record per agent file in this directory. node .skilled/bin/sync-agent-roster.cjs writes the generated roster blocks from it, and --check fails when a block or the directory disagrees.

agents.name: context
agents.taskType: ALL codebase exploration, file search, pattern discovery, context loading
agents.skills: Trigger index lookup, Glob, Grep, Read
agents.notes: Sub-agent with direct retrieval only. Routes ALL exploration tasks
agents.summary: retrieval-first context agent with canonical continuity recovery, read-only

agents.name: deep-research
agents.notes: LEAF agent; iterative autonomous research loop with externalized state
agents.summary: autonomous deep-research iterations with externalized state

agents.name: ai-council
agents.notes: Planning-only multi-strategy architect (max 3 strategies). Post-dispatch responsibility: when @orchestrate dispatches at Depth 1, run `node .skilled/skills/system-deep-loop/deep-ai-council/scripts/persist-artifacts.cjs <packet>` after the LEAF returns to persist `ai-council/` artifacts (see ai-council persistence protocol). If the LEAF's returned report shows `max_rounds` reached without a converged plan (check `current_round >= max_rounds` in `ai-council-config.json`), add `--not-converged` to that invocation — the helper cannot detect max-round exhaustion on its own and defaults to `convergence:true` otherwise.
agents.summary: multi-strategy AI Council planning, writes only ai-council artifacts

templateExceptions.reason: Twelve files in the deep-ai-council skill cite this agent's sections 3 to 17 by number, so the section sits after them and no cited number moves.

agents.name: markdown
agents.taskType: `/create:*` documentation and component creation command execution
agents.notes: Template-first documentation executor for `/create:*`, scoped markdown, and spec-doc authoring
agents.summary: template-first markdown and documentation executor for /create:* commands and spec docs

agents.name: review
agents.skills: `sk-code` code-review mode (findings-first baseline + router-selected surface evidence)
agents.notes: Codebase-agnostic code review; verdict follows severity, score is advisory
agents.summary: read-only code-review specialist, pattern validation and quality scoring

agents.name: deep-review
agents.taskType: Deep-loop iterative code-audit pass (`/deep:review` only — explicit deep-loop convergence request, not a one-shot review)
agents.notes: LEAF agent; iterative code-audit dimension pass, P0/P1/P2 findings, JSONL state
agents.summary: deep-review iteration agent, one dimension per pass with P0/P1/P2 findings

templateExceptions.reason: Its output is the iteration file and the state rows that its REVIEW CONTRACT section defines, so a second format section would restate them.

agents.name: code
agents.skills: `sk-code` (stack-agnostic; sk-code performs detection at dispatch time); orchestrator dispatches `@review` separately for formal review
agents.notes: Application-code LEAF; sk-code stack delegation; D3 convention-floor caller-restriction (`Depth: 1` marker required); fail-closed verify
agents.summary: application-code implementation via sk-code, write-capable LEAF dispatched only by orchestrate

templateExceptions.reason: It returns a fixed contract under RETURN CONTRACT, and the orchestrator cites that section by that name.

agents.name: debug
agents.taskType: Debugging when `failure_count >= 3` — workflow surfaces a prompted offer; user opts in via the runtime's delegation tool. Never auto-dispatched.
agents.summary: user-invoked fresh-perspective debugger, 5-phase root-cause method, never auto-dispatched

agents.name: design
agents.taskType: UI values and behavior, measuring a live surface into a Style Reference, charts and diagrams
agents.notes: Write-capable LEAF; decides UI values and measures a live surface into a Style Reference
agents.summary: design specialist across two skills: decides UI values from sk-code-frontend's visual references, measures a live surface into a Style Reference via sk-design-md-generator, LEAF

agents.name: prompt-improver
agents.taskType: Prompt creation and improvement, including dispatch-ready CLI prompts
agents.notes: Read-only LEAF; returns a structured prompt package and never executes it
agents.summary: prompt-engineering specialist, framework selection and CLEAR validation

agents.name: orchestrate
agents.taskType: Task decomposition, delegation, evaluation and synthesis
agents.notes: Top-level orchestrator; the only agent that dispatches others
agents.summary: senior multi-agent orchestration, decomposition, delegation and synthesis

templateExceptions.reason: It delivers a synthesis shaped by the request under SYNTHESIS & DELIVERY and has no fixed output shape of its own.

routingExtras.taskType: External CLI execution — ONLY when the user names an executor; never auto-selected
